Package IoTFleetManagement.user.service

Klasse CustomUserDetailsService

java.lang.Object
IoTFleetManagement.user.service.CustomUserDetailsService
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService
@Service public class CustomUserDetailsService extends Object implements org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService
Implementation of UserDetailsService for loading user-specific data.

This service integrates with the UserRepository to retrieve user details and adapts them into a CustomUserDetails object for Spring Security.

Autor:
Lara, Jasmin1707

  • Methodendetails

    • loadUserByUsername

      public org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String username) throws org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException
      Loads a user by their username.

      This method retrieves the user from the database using the UserRepository. If the user is found, it wraps the user entity in a CustomUserDetails object. If the user is not found, a UsernameNotFoundException is thrown.

      Angegeben von:
      loadUserByUsername in Schnittstelle org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetailsService
      Parameter:
      username - the username of the user to be loaded
      Gibt zurück:
      a CustomUserDetails object containing user details
      Löst aus:
      org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UsernameNotFoundException - if no user is found with the given username
